user.title: Connect Syphere Parcelbox
user.description: Sign in with your Syphere account. The password is used only for the login exchange and is not stored in the Home Assistant config entry. Client ID is optional and only needed for deployments that require it during the initial OAuth request.

reauth_confirm.title: Reconnect Syphere Parcelbox
reauth_confirm.description: Sign in again with your Syphere account. The password is not stored.

error.invalid_auth: Login failed. Check email and password. If your Syphere deployment requires a Client ID during login, enter it as well.
error.client_id_required: Login succeeded, but the Client ID could not be determined automatically. Enter the Client ID and try again.

abort.already_configured: This Syphere Parcelbox is already configured.
